description: This source file implements a PyTorch backend interface for integrating CoreML models into a larger machine learning pipeline on iOS and macOS platforms. It includes functions for compiling, executing, and managing CoreML models, as well as utility macros and JSON parsing routines specific to this backend.

classes.name: CoreMLBackend
classes.description: An implementation of torch::jit::PyTorchBackendInterface for CoreML, providing methods to compile and execute CoreML models within the PyTorch JIT backend system.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a CoreML model from processed inputs and specifications, returning a handle for inference.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes inference on a compiled CoreML model using provided inputs.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the CoreML backend is available on the current platform.
